# Data desk notes

## Removing a person's exported records

After a verified removal request, erase the person's downloadable archive and
the temporary export token. Keep only the request identifier and completion
time in the compliance ledger.

## Helping someone retrieve an archive

Support may resend a download link after confirming the account owner. The link
expires after one hour; do not attach the archive to an email.

# Field guide

## Reversing a rollout

When a release causes a customer-facing regression, point the traffic switch at
the previously tagged image. Record the incident identifier before changing the
switch, and do not delete the failed image until the follow-up is complete.

## Reviewing a proposal

Describe the behavior that concerns you, cite the smallest example, and suggest
a next step. Avoid labels about the author; the review should make the change
easier to improve.
